main_text.p: tas. in N.T. nomen DEI יהוה redditur KY'PIOΣ, DOMINUS. inprimis sic nominatur D.N. JESUS, qui sanguine suo nos redemit, Joh.21.7. κυριός ἐστι. Cæsar Rom.13. dicitur ἄρχων minister, & idem ratione officii dicitur Act.25.26. κυριος. item σεβαστὸς augustus, venerabilis. & sic vocabulum κυριος opponitur subdito τῷ δεσπότῃ. item κυριος vertitur herus, paterfamilias; & opponitur servo Col.3.23. 1.Pet.3.6. Est & vocabulum honoris, Joh.12.21. Act.10.3.
Κυριεύω dominor cum Genit. F. εύσω. a.1. ἐκυριεύσα. prat.act. κεκυριεύκα.
Κυρόω ῶ fancio. F. ώσω. a.1. ἐκύρωσα. P. κεκύρωκα. fancivi. prat.pass. κεκύρωμαι, Gal.3.15.
Κύων canis. Genit. κυνὸς ὁ ἡ item, impudentes doctores dicuntur κύνες Philip.3.2. item scortatores Deut.23.11. Apoc.22.15.
Κωλύω prohibeo, arceo, inhibeo. Fut. ὑσω. P. κεκώλυκα. aor.1. act. ἐκώλυσα. a.1.infin. κωλῦσαι. prae.pass. κωλύομαι prohibeor. aor.1.pass. ἐκωλύθην.
Κώμη ης ἡ vicus, pagus. κώμη ὣν-αἱ pagi.
Κῶμος ὁ comessatio. hinc κωμάζω comessor.
Κώνωψ ωπος ὁ ἡ culex, ex κῶν & ὤψ, quia facies culicis in acutum exit.
Κωφὸς ἡ ὁν. mutus a um.

page.notes: Right margin of the facing page is a narrow, heavily cropped strip with fragmentary notes (e.g. "Act.9.5", "Matth.", "Latinè", "accipio", "verbo"); largely illegible, not transcribed. Greek and Hebrew words in the main text are approximate transcriptions of the printed forms; the Hebrew יהוה and several Greek accents are uncertain. The "A A." at the foot is a signature-like mark at the end of the text.
